# Authored synthetic fixture

All labels, addresses, measurements and API-shaped responses were authored for offline tests on 2026-10-22. These are not captured API recordings or verified premises. Coordinates and a simple rectangle illustrate membership around Midland TX without claiming a real service zone. The twenty records include in-zone, outside, boundary, two borderline times, a polygon/time disagreement, zero valid time and a tied maximum. Matrix cells are deliberately reordered. Category service is a broad candidate class, not a verified plumber taxonomy.
